label: preparing
what: A catered evening gathering in the great hall, with 200 loaves of bread and eight lanterns, organized as hospitality alongside the scheduled lighting inspection/meeting. The baker knowingly supplied the bread; builder and freight coordinated with the innkeeper. The neighbour learns of the arrangements but is not clearly part of organizing them. The records do not establish that this was deliberately concealed from the mayor; some details were kept under their control, but the mayor was told about the hall appointment and eventually the catering.
